This carries 'husbands and wives' and the limit 'though not perform it alone' without drift. Wilson's note on mithunah reports the same reading and names Sayana. Plain sense: day.js shows 1.131.1 with Dyaus and Earth bowed to Indra and 1.131.2 to 5 on men urging him in libations, the couples, and his suppliants; no four-word run of the key. Hard-passage rule met: the limit is given and attributed, no softening. verse.js ok (Rig Veda 1.131.3, at [130,3]); entry-check ok, no warns. No school needed, no comparison.
